skill.name: slideshow
skill.description: Create HyperFrames slideshows with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, presenter mode, and speaker notes. Convert existing pages into runnable decks while preserving media, motion, and interaction behavior.
skill.summary: Create interactive HyperFrames presentation decks with slides, branches, hotspots, and presenter mode.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown backticks, sample code, object keys, and local relative paths. No prompt injection, credential material, shell execution, path traversal, or system reconnaissance intent was found. One low-severity issue remains because an optional Three.js example imports code from a third-party CDN.

remediation.issue: Optional Three.js example loads executable code from jsdelivr at runtime.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a vendored or package-managed Three.js dependency, and document integrity or lockfile requirements for copied examples.

content.value_statement: Interactive presentation decks are hard to structure, validate, and hand off. This skill guides HyperFrames slideshow authoring with slide manifests, navigation, media handling, and presenter mode.
actual_capabilities: Defines the HyperFrames slideshow manifest for slides, fragments, hotspots, and branch sequences.
Guides conversion of existing pages into decks while preserving media, motion, layout, and interactions.
Explains use of built-in presenter mode, audience tabs, speaker notes, navigation, and mute behavior.
Documents standalone wrapper patterns for demos until engine-hosted slideshow preview is available.
Provides validation steps for linting slideshow structure and checking runtime behavior before handoff.
limitations: It does not render a complete slideshow as one MP4 file.
It depends on HyperFrames player and slideshow components.
Standalone demos may require a duplicated slideshow manifest until engine-hosted preview is available.
Text-to-speech fields are reserved but playback is not wired by this skill.

use_cases.title: Build an Investor Pitch Deck
use_cases.description: Create a structured deck with claims, visuals, speaker notes, and optional market-sizing branches.

use_cases.title: Convert a Product Page
use_cases.description: Turn an existing interactive page into a navigable deck while keeping motion, media, and custom controls.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Live Demo Presentation
use_cases.description: Create a presenter-ready deck with audience mode, media sync guidance, and validation before handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a HyperFrames slideshow with five slides, speaker notes, clear claims, and built-in presenter mode.

prompt_templates.title: Add Reveals and Hotspots
prompt_templates.prompt: Add fragment reveals and one hotspot branch to this HyperFrames slideshow. Keep each slide focused on one idea.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Page to Slides
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this existing page into a HyperFrames slideshow. Preserve its media controls, motion, layout, and interaction behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Final Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this HyperFrames slideshow, fix lint and runtime issues, then prepare it for presenter-mode handoff.

output_examples.input: A founder needs a five-slide investor pitch with a market-sizing branch.
output_examples.output: A runnable HyperFrames deck with main slides, a branch for market details, speaker notes, and presenter navigation.

output_examples.input: A designer wants a landing page converted into a presentation.
output_examples.output: A deck that preserves the page visuals, media behavior, transitions, and slide-to-slide navigation.

output_examples.input: A product team needs a live demo deck for a video call.
output_examples.output: A presenter-ready slideshow with audience mode guidance, media handling notes, and validation steps.

best_practices: Use one clear claim and one primary visual per slide.
Validate the slideshow manifest and runtime behavior before handoff.
Use built-in presenter mode and speaker notes instead of custom wrapper controls.
anti_patterns: Do not export the deck as one MP4 when the user needs interactive navigation.
Do not place branch slides in the main slide sequence.
Do not replace source-specific media controls or interactions with simplified placeholders unless requested.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates runnable HyperFrames slideshow decks with slides, navigation, fragments, branches, and presenter mode.

faq.question: Can it export a full slideshow video?
faq.answer: No. The supported output is a live navigable deck, with per-slide stills when needed.

faq.question: Does it support speaker notes?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill uses the shared presenter mode notes behavior and avoids one-off note editors.

faq.question: Can it convert existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides conversion while preserving layout, motion, media behavior, and important interactive details.

faq.question: Does it support branching slides?
faq.answer: Yes. Hotspots can open branch sequences that stay separate from the main slide path.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: The deck depends on HyperFrames player, slideshow components, and validation commands from the HyperFrames workflow.
